lines.zh: 我贴着地面挪，动作很轻。
lines.en: I creep along the ground, my movements light.

lines.zh: 我一步一晃，像在学走路。
lines.en: I wobble with each step, as if still learning.
I keep to my anchor. Not far.

lines.zh: 我跳过一截树根，栽了一下。
lines.en: I hop a root and stumble.
I shift over to my owner's feet.

lines.zh: 我朝草地上那块亮处走。
lines.en: I head for the bright patch on the grass.

lines.zh: 我两条小腿走得很认真。
lines.en: My two small legs walk with great care.

lines.zh: 我从那块圆石后头挪出来。
lines.en: I shuffle out from behind the round stone.
Two steps, then a look up.

lines.zh: 我踩在落叶上，声音很脆。
lines.en: My steps on the litter crackle.

lines.zh: 我朝队伍的边上靠过去。
lines.en: I ease toward the edge of the group.

lines.zh: 我顺着坡往下走，刹不住。
lines.en: I start down the slope and can't stop.
I sit with my legs one before the other.

lines.zh: 我在看自己短短的爪子。
lines.en: I'm looking at my short little claws.

lines.zh: 我还很小，能做的事情不多。
lines.en: I'm small. There's not much I can do.

lines.zh: 有只虫爬过我脚边，我看它。
lines.en: An insect crosses my foot. I watch it.
I'm waiting for my owner to pat my head.

lines.zh: 风把我的耳朵吹得一抖。
lines.en: The wind twitches my ears.

lines.zh: 我把尾巴收进来，暖一点。
lines.en: I tuck my tail in for warmth.

lines.zh: 这一片草地，我每天都来。
lines.en: This meadow is mine every day.
I lift my face and sniff around.

lines.zh: 我不太会站着不动，总是晃。
lines.en: I can't stand still. I always sway.
I perk my ears and listen to the grass.

lines.zh: 太阳照在我背上，很舒服。
lines.en: The sun on my back feels good.

lines.zh: 我试着跳高，只跳了一点点。
lines.en: I try to jump. Barely any height.

lines.zh: 我把一块小石头踢来踢去。
lines.en: I kick a pebble back and forth.
Could I take you as my owner?
I'm this small. Crouch down.
Your feet are huge. I'll walk around them.
What's that food in your hand?
I look up. I can't see all of you.
Don't step on me. I'm right here.
I know your scent. Familiar.
May I come along with you?
I haven't been tamed yet.
If you're petting me, go slowly.

lines.zh: 我这样，你会不会看不起我？
lines.en: Looking like this, do you think less of me?

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在看你，没有眨。
lines.en: My eyes are on you and haven't blinked.
If you leave, I'll follow.

lines.zh: 你先站着别动，我走不稳。
lines.en: Stand still. I'm unsteady.

lines.zh: 我太小了，容易被人忽略。
lines.en: I'm so small I'm easily overlooked.

lines.zh: 你的影子把我整个人吞了。
lines.en: Your shadow swallows all of me.

lines.zh: 一格的小东西，摔了也能爬。
lines.en: One block of a thing, and I still get up.
That folded me into a ball.
Not much pain. Only fright.
I scraped off some skin; it stings.
I duck behind that flat stone.
My eyes sting a little.
I shake myself clean of dirt.

lines.zh: 我往草里退了半步，泡泡还在嘴边。
lines.en: I step back into the grass, a bubble at my lip.
A sleep will mend this.
I raise my head, faintly wronged.
Feed for in-training ones?
I caught the smell. Very nice.

lines.zh: 放低些，我个子太小够不着。
lines.en: Lower it. I'm too small to reach.
All day I bounce around the anchor.
Two hops and still short.
Step back so I can come over.
That'll keep me going half a day.
After I eat I'll follow you.
Don't hold it up so high.
That smell settles me.
I shift over. No hurry.
I'd like to keep the rest.

lines.zh: 你抬脚的时候差点碰着我。
lines.en: Your foot nearly caught me when it lifted.
One knock and I'm on my back.
Two steps back and steady.
Don't press close. I can't hold my feet.
I walk around your boot.

lines.zh: 这一下，我的腿打了个绊。
lines.en: That tangled my legs.

lines.zh: 你身上的土落在我这儿。
lines.en: Your dust has settled on me.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，我先歪了。
lines.en: We bumped and I went crooked first.
You're strong. I'm afraid.

lines.zh: 我躲在石头后面，你就碰不到我了。
lines.en: I'm behind the stone. Now you can't reach me.
I'm too small for that.
Wait until I grow a bit taller.
Crouch down first.
I'd have to ask my owner.
You smell like wind from beyond the woods.
I prefer curling up in a corner.
I still need looking after.
Ask again once I've evolved.
My tail is mine; don't touch.
This is good enough for me.
I can't lift it. I can only press it.
That feed. One bite.
I push it to your feet.

lines.zh: 我一步一晃，太重的东西推不动。
lines.en: I sway along; anything too heavy will not budge.
That one on the ground. Mine.
I carry it in my mouth as I go.

lines.zh: 东西掉了，我找了一会儿。
lines.en: It fell. I hunted a while.
I don't want to eat this yet.

lines.zh: 我塞进那块石头底下的缝。
lines.en: I push it into the gap under the stone.
Wrong taste. I spat it out.
Something's moving on the grass.
I fix on that insect.
Something large is coming.
I can't stray from my anchor too long.
My owner's over there. I'll go.
I lift my ears and listen.
That blade of grass is shaking.
With my owner near, I don't panic.
It's taller than I am.

lines.zh: 我看见了，脚却不听使唤。
lines.en: I saw it, and my feet wouldn't answer.
Something's fallen to the ground.
I shift one small step that way.
One shift, then a pause.
I hide beneath a blade of grass.
One twitch from it and I answer.

lines.zh: 我趴在草里，只有草籽那么高。
lines.en: Flat in the grass, I am barely seed-high.
I inch closer to it, inch by inch.
The grass is too thick to move fast.

lines.zh: 你背对我时，我才挪一步。
lines.en: I move only when your back is turned.
One body length left.
If I move, it'll see.
I shrink back under the grass.
This position is just right for my bite.

lines.zh: 我的腿在抖，可是我没退。
lines.en: My legs shake, and I don't back down.
I puff out a water bubble.
That hit its instep.
I lunge and cling on.
It pulls away and I hit the ground.

lines.zh: 这一下我咬住它的靴带。
lines.en: That bite caught its bootlace.
The bubble burst and splashed it.
I get up and go again.

lines.zh: 这一下不重，可我很用力。
lines.en: It wasn't heavy, but I tried hard.
Its foot came up and I rolled aside.
I land in the grass and vanish.
All a Baby II can do is ram.
I'm not down yet.

lines.zh: 我从草里钻出来，很小一只。
lines.en: I come out of the grass. A small one.
My kind often come to this meadow.

lines.zh: 我的锚点就在这棵树下面。
lines.en: My anchor's under this tree.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖，露水掉了一地。
lines.en: I shake and the dew scatters.
I'm newly out of the egg.
The sun's warm, so I creep out.

lines.zh: 我跳到了一个陌生的地方。
lines.en: I've hopped somewhere I don't know.
I look around before I dare move.
I land on a flat stone.

lines.zh: 有主人叫我了，我这就来。
lines.en: My owner called. I'm coming.
I'm hidden in tall grass.

lines.zh: 我从树根缝里钻出来，很小。
lines.en: I squeeze out of the root gap, very small.

lines.zh: 热一来，我的绒毛就卷了。
lines.en: The heat arrives and my fuzz shrivels.

lines.zh: 我滑下石头，翻了好几个滚。
lines.en: I slide off the stone and roll over and over.
Soaked through, I can't move.
The blast blows me into the grass.
Something pointed jabbed me.

lines.zh: 有股力定住我，我挣不开。
lines.en: A force holds me. I can't break it.

lines.zh: 太久没吃，我连跳都跳不动。
lines.en: Too long without food. I can't even hop.
Thunder sounds and I go numb.

lines.zh: 我一直在掉，找不到落处。
lines.en: I drop endlessly with nothing to catch.
